logout.error: It was not possible to log out.

privacy.title: Collection privacy
privacy.description: Choose who can see the games in your collection.
privacy.privateDescription: Only you can see your collection.
privacy.friendsDescription: Only accepted friends can see your collection.
privacy.publicDescription: Any user can see your collection.

about.title: About and credits
about.data: Names, covers, year, players, playing time, age, complexity, descriptions, categories, mechanics, expansions and the BGG rating come from the BoardGameGeek XML API.
about.dataNote: Descriptions stay in the original language. Matches, ratings, libraries and friends are MeepleBoard data and are not sent to BoardGameGeek.
about.meepleBoardHint: Average of matches recorded in the app

durationSharing.title: Statistics privacy
durationSharing.label: Contribute to community match durations
durationSharing.used: What is used: the duration and its method (timed, estimate or not stated), the game, the mode and the number of players of matches you took part in.
durationSharing.never: What is never used: names, dates, places, results, scores, ratings and notes.
durationSharing.when: When it counts: only in matches where every participant turned this on. Includes earlier matches.
durationSharing.how: How it appears: only as an anonymous average per game, never single matches, and only with enough matches from several people.
durationSharing.offEffect: If you turn it off: your matches stop counting from that moment. Your own average does not change.
durationSharing.changeError: This preference could not be changed.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.deleted: Profile, email, friends, collection, notes, ratings, photos and publications.
deleteAccount.kept: Your place and result in shared matches, as «Deleted account», so others' history does not change. What others wrote is not touched.
deleteAccount.neutral: The names you gave shared sessions and campaigns, and the place, summary and tags of matches you created.
deleteAccount.providers: Access ends at once. Backups and provider logs disappear at the end of their period, described in the privacy policy.
deleteAccount.loadError: Your sessions and campaigns could not be loaded.
deleteAccount.scheduledHint: Guests see it as cancelled in the app and get a notification if they turned them on.
deleteAccount.runningHint: Matches stay saved for the participants.
deleteAccount.campaignsHint: Without a new manager, the campaign goes on for its members, but nobody can delete it or remove members.
deleteAccount.notes: They may hold text by other members and stay with the campaign. Review them before deleting.
deleteAccount.onlyYours_one: {{count}} campaign that is only yours will be deleted.
deleteAccount.onlyYours_other: {{count}} campaigns that are only yours will be deleted.
deleteAccount.nobodyHint: The campaign stays with its members; nobody can delete it or remove members.
deleteAccount.forgotHint: We email you a link; once you set it, you come back to this screen.
deleteAccount.resetSent: We sent a link to {{email}}. Once you set the new password, you come back to this screen.
deleteAccount.resetError: The link could not be sent.
deleteAccount.error: The account could not be deleted.
